lines.text: Moses asks his father-in-law Jethro to let him return to Egypt, and the LORD tells him to go back.
Moses puts his wife and sons on a donkey and heads for Egypt with the staff of God.
The LORD tells Moses to tell Pharaoh that Israel is His firstborn son, and that He will kill Pharaoh's firstborn son.
At a lodging place the LORD is about to kill Moses, but his wife Zipporah takes a flint knife and circumcises her son.
Aaron meets Moses at the mountain of God, and the people believe when Aaron speaks and Moses performs the signs.
